image_description: A large, ornate pipe organ installed in a stone gallery or loft within a church or cathedral. The instrument features a symmetrical arrangement of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, with the tallest pipes in the center creating a stepped silhouette. The casing is made of reddish-brown wood with decorative moldings and carved details. The organ is situated between stone arches.
